newsitem.title: FRANCE: LVMH selling Guinness shares - mkt sources.
newsitem.headline: LVMH selling Guinness shares - mkt sources.

text.p: French luxury goods group LVMH has retained Goldman Sachs to sell around a third of its 21 percent stake in British drinks group Guinness Plc at 414 pence per share, market sources in Paris said on Friday.
Officials at LVMH were not immediately available for comment.
Dealers said Goldman was placing 135 million Guinness shares, or around seven percent.

LVMH has recently put pressure on Guinness to increase shareholder value. One analyst said the French company may be taking advantage of sterling's recent rise against the franc to carry out the sale, which she estimated would generate five billion francs for LVMH.
She said LVMH may be selling the Guinness shares to help finance its 12.9 billion franc purchase of control of U.S. duty free chain DFS.
Shares in LVMH were up 5.2 percent at 1,580 francs at 0915 GMT on the Paris bourse, whose CAC index was up 0.2 percent at the same time.
